caption: The drawing consists of a grid composed of numerous rectangular and square sections, each containing individual motifs. The motifs primarily feature various flowers, leaves, and plants, with several sections depicting pairs of birds, individual birds, and butterflies. Some blocks have animals, such as a white and black dog, and another contains two human figures standing close together. The background color throughout the grid is dark, possibly black or deep brown, and the illustrations are created with muted shades of green, pink, peach, blue, yellow, and cream. Many floral designs have extensive use of pink and green, while occasional sections use striped backgrounds in pastel shades. All the designs are stylized with detailed embroidery-like effects, and the whole composition is bordered with a light edge. The grid is evenly spaced, with each section separated by thin borders, making it easy to distinguish each motif.
title: Caswell Carpet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
